symptom: email sign-in answered 500 on a database written by a build that never recorded a purpose, while the same code passed on a freshly created file
root_cause: SCHEMA is a pile of CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS: it creates a table this database has never seen and never corrects one an older build already wrote, so the deployed command log kept its legacy key and no purpose column

migration.legacy_row_rationale: login is what wrote this log before the column existed, and a replay re-checks purpose, request MAC and subject before it answers
migration.boot_order: repaired before db.exec(SCHEMA), so every later migration finds the shape it expects

schema_drift_sweep.additive_drift: ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN from the declaration SCHEMA already carries
schema_drift_sweep.declared_vs_created: audited against the same text the DDL is built from

verification.fixtures: local copies in the OS temp directory; no real rows touched

rollback.manual_rollback: stop the service and restore the pre-deploy /data/nexus.sqlite copy; the rewrite itself never needs it because it runs in one transaction
rollback.deploy_rollback_target: a build that already writes the purpose column; an older build cannot write this table

deploy.path: Railway service source is this GitHub repository, branch main, built from the repository-root Dockerfile, one volume at /data, health check /health
deploy.trigger: a push to main re-deploys the service; a push to another branch does not
